trainingBlocks.name: Winter Arc 1 · Intro
trainingBlocks.notes:
4 weeks of mostly machines at moderate reps, ramping effort each week. About 8–10 sets per muscle per week. Goal: re-teach the body to lift, not to set PRs.
RIR by week: week 1 at 4 RIR (find working weights), week 2 at 3 (add reps or load where it felt easy), week 3 at 2 (first real push), week 4 at 1–2 (push it, then roll into Block 2).
Double progression: when every set hits the top of the rep range at the target RIR, add load (+2.5 kg upper body, +5 kg lower body), then build reps back up. Rest 2–3 min on compounds, 1–2 min on isolations. Warm-up: 5 min easy cardio, then 2–3 ramp-up sets on the first compound. Sharp or joint pain: swap the exercise.

trainingBlocks.name: Winter Arc 2 · Core 1
trainingBlocks.notes:
Compounds lead every session; A days go heavy (5–8 reps), B days go hypertrophy (8–12 reps). About 12–16 sets per muscle per week. Two 6-week waves, each ending in a deload.
RIR (compounds / isolations): weeks 1–2 and 7–8: 3 / 2. Weeks 3–4 and 9–10: 2 / 1. Weeks 5 and 11: 1 / 0 (to failure). Weeks 6 (5–11 Jan) and 12 (16–22 Feb): deload, same exercises, half the sets, 4+ RIR.
Week 4 lands on Christmas; if the holidays wreck the schedule, swap it with the week 6 deload.
Gauge progress by the big four (squat, bench, deadlift, pull-up): by week 12, clearly more weight or reps than in week 1.
Double progression: when every set hits the top of the rep range at the target RIR, add load (+2.5 kg upper body, +5 kg lower body), then build reps back up. Rest 2–3 min on compounds, 1–2 min on isolations. Warm-up: 5 min easy cardio, then 2–3 ramp-up sets on the first compound. Sharp or joint pain: swap the exercise.

trainingBlocks.name: Winter Arc 3 · Core 2 · M1
trainingBlocks.notes:
Block 3, mesocycle 1 (weeks 1–6), exercise set Option 1.
Each mesocycle: weeks 1–2 at 3 RIR, weeks 3–4 at 2 RIR, week 5 at 0–1 RIR, week 6 deload (same exercises, half the sets, 4+ RIR). Add one set to the main lift of each lagging muscle in weeks 3–5. Intensity techniques (myo-reps, drop sets, lengthened partials) on the last set of isolation exercises only, never on squats or deadlifts. About 14–20 sets per muscle per week.
Cardio (low-impact, mostly Zone 2) on Mon, Thu or Sun, or after Pull sessions, never right before squats or deadlifts: 2 × 25 min Zone 2 a week; deload week 2 × 20 min easy. Plus 8,000–10,000 steps a day.
Double progression: when every set hits the top of the rep range at the target RIR, add load (+2.5 kg upper body, +5 kg lower body), then build reps back up. Rest 2–3 min on compounds, 1–2 min on isolations. Warm-up: 5 min easy cardio, then 2–3 ramp-up sets on the first compound. Sharp or joint pain: swap the exercise.

Week 25 (10–16 Aug): work up to heavy triples on the big four (squat, bench, deadlift, pull-up). Week 26 (17–23 Aug): deload.
Each mesocycle: weeks 1–2 at 3 RIR, weeks 3–4 at 2 RIR, week 5 at 0–1 RIR, week 6 deload (same exercises, half the sets, 4+ RIR). Add one set to the main lift of each lagging muscle in weeks 3–5.
